$comment: Corrections to upstream `shapeISO` values, applied by scripts/finalize_geojson.py.
Keyed by ISO3, then level, then the feature's `src_shape_id` (the geoBoundaries
id). A value of "" clears the code. The key "*" applies to every feature of
that level. Every entry here is a documented upstream error: the corrected code
is the ISO 3166-2 code of the unit named in `shapeName`.
Do not use this file to invent codes. If a unit has no ISO 3166-2 code, leave
`shapeISO` empty and let the feature `id` fall back to the name-based key.
